put.summary: Save the signed-in member’s plan for a week
put.description: Replaces the week’s plan; repeating a save gives the same result. Past weeks are read-only, later weeks change freely, and a member plans up to 4 weeks ahead. In the current week, from the day the member joined: days before today stay as they were, today stays a training or a rest day (its sport may change), and the number of rest days is fixed. On the day a member joins, a week still on the default changes freely. Days are read in the member’s profile time zone, and a day lasts until 3am.

400.description: Not a valid plan or not a Monday; a week that is over (`WEEK_OVER`) or too far ahead (`WEEK_TOO_FAR_AHEAD`); a change to a day that has started (`PLAN_DAY_STARTED`) or to this week’s number of rest days (`REST_DAYS_FIXED`); or no profile yet (`TIME_ZONE_NOT_SET`)
